{
  "name": "tqdm-claude",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "author": {
    "name": "ExtReMLapin",
    "url": "https://github.com/ExtReMLapin"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/ExtReMLapin/tqdm-claude",
  "repository": "https://github.com/ExtReMLapin/tqdm-claude",
  "license": "MIT",
  "icon": "./.claude-plugin/icon.png",
  "keywords": [
    "progress-bar",
    "tqdm",
    "background-tasks",
    "subagents",
    "mod"
  ],
  "description": "Claude Code mod: live tqdm-style progress bars above the prompt for background tasks and subagents, with crash and stall detection.",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "charset": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Progress glyphs",
      "description": "auto picks unicode, or ascii where the locale names a charset that is not UTF-8. unicode: eighth-cell bars and a braille spinner. blocks: full and shaded cells only (code page 437), for a font that lacks the others. ascii: # and - like tqdm's ascii mode.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "unicode",
        "blocks",
        "ascii"
      ]
    },
    "footer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Summary in the footer",
      "description": "Where the line under the prompt sums up running and failed tasks. mode: a label at its right, beside Claude Code's own mode labels, never cut. tail: after Claude Code's task pills on the left, cut where the line runs out. both, or off.",
      "default": "mode",
      "options": [
        "mode",
        "tail",
        "both",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "agents": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Follow subagents",
      "description": "Also shows subagents (the tasks list's agent rows) with their elapsed time and how they ended.",
      "default": true
    },
    "notify": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Notifications",
      "description": "A native notification (your notification channel) when a task ends. failures: a failure or an early end. always: also a stop, and a success that took a minute or more. off: none.",
      "default": "failures",
      "options": [
        "failures",
        "always",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "stuck": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Stuck-turn warning",
      "description": "Warns in the band when a turn has had no tool call start or end for 3 minutes: Claude may be stuck.",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
